svg.aria-label: Map of Equatorial Guinea: Río Muni, Bioko and Annobón shown as separate geographic regions
svg.metadata: Equatorial Guinea target geometry: geoBoundaries gbOpen GNQ ADM2 boundary GNQ-ADM2-11065452, boundary year 2013, WGS84, CC BY 4.0, pinned mirror bf892371c17a281d3d6764c61b8e85ce76d0c264; includes Río Muni, Bioko, Annobón, Corisco, Elobey Grande and Elobey Chico. National outline cross-check: Natural Earth 1:10m GNQ. Geographic context for mainland and Bioko: Natural Earth 1:10m Cameroon and Gabon via LonnyGomes/CountryGeoJSONCollection commit 5120290da88f3f205f74aa55f3c8fa1f19d1bc8b. Three geographically accurate local WGS84 regions use the shared JOURNEY ATLAS multi-region map pattern; their positions and scales between panels are intentionally not geographic. Checked 2026-09-29.
